name: State Grid Yingda Co.,Ltd.
summary: State Grid Yingda Co.,Ltd. engages in the trust, securities, futures, carbon assets, and power equipment businesses in China and internationally. It offers electrical distribution transformers, amorphous iron cores, integrated substations, integrated primary and secondary equipment, C-GIS, gas-filled switchgear, surge arresters, AC and DC bushings, insulated towers, nano-aluminum alloy fittings, insulators, lightning monitoring, and warning technology services.
